# PeerDAS Breakout Room - Call #26 | April 22, 2025 - [Apr 22, 2025, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/apr-22-2025/2pm) - Zoom link: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/s/82523885094 ### Resources - [Ethereum Protocol Call calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t) - [PeerDAS-PM.md](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Breakout-Room-Meetings/PeerDAS/PeerDAS-pm.md) - [Google Doc Meeting Notes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ng2IrCe28kTt1BnIsjtMlKHq2MHgaja24LhFXSvqfJQ/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.2za2utdyu31m) - [Previous call](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1441) - Facilitator email: [will@ethreum.org](mailto:will@ethreum.org) # Agenda Overview A. Client Updates B. Devnet / Testing Updates C. Spec / EIP Discussion D. Open Discussion # Agenda Details ## Client Updates ### CL Client Teams | Team | Active ICs | Call 25 Update | |------|------------|----------------| | [Lighthouse](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3Adas) | Jimmy + Sunnyside Labs IC | No update provided. | | [Prysm](https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/14129) | Manu & Terence + Francis & Niram from Base | Working on data column verification pipeline and implementing blobs bundle v2 structure to replace current v1 hack with extended size limit. | | [Teku](https://github.com/Consensys/teku/issues/9274) | Dmitrii + Jerone Ost from Soneium | Completed distributed cell proofs implementation; merging PR - aim to join devnet-6 and starting 2-month transition of PeerDAS code to production. | | [Nimbus](https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+fulu+) | Agnish & Dustin | **NEW:** OOO, current focus: Investigating issues in the current devnet-6, improving column syncing for nimbus-eth2 | | [Lodestar](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/issues/7429) | Matt K, Katya + Derek & Hugh from Base | Merged validator custody and getBlobsV2; implementing second column pull with metrics and making progress on multi-month refactor. | | [Grandine](https://github.com/grandinetech/grandine/pull/55) | Hangleang & Saulius Grigaitis | Investigating Grandine-Reth pairing issues, suspecting slow payload processing on Reth side. | ### EL Client Teams | Team | Active ICs | Call 24 Update | |------|------------|----------------| | [Geth](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pulls) | Felix, Marius, Lightclient | - No updated provided.
- Sunnyside testing showed it used less resources while handling ~45 blobs per block. | | [Nethermind](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/8417) | FLCL, Marcin | Added metrics for getBlobs success/failure rates and working on PoC for SS endpoint for getBlobsV2. | | [Reth](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/15534) | Roman | Investigating high block processing times causing pairing failures with Lighthouse and Grandine. | | [Besu](https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pulls) | tbd | - No updated provided.
- Sunnyside testing showed it achieved highest performance (50 blobs per block). | | [Erigon](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pulls) | tbd | - No updated provided.
- Sunnyside testing showed it achieved lowest performance (18 blobs per block). | | [ethereumjs](https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pulls) | Gajinder | Working on PR; extending micro-eth-signer with cell functions and bundling CKG for devnets while waiting for library updates. | ## Devnet / Testing Updates | Topic | Subtopic | Details | |-------|----------|---------| | **peerdas-devnet-6** | current status | Pari to voice over | | | next steps | Pari to voice over | **Sunnyside Labs** (recent activity): - [Shared 04/15 Update](https://testinprod.notion.site/Sunnyside-Devnet-Updates-04-15-1d18fc57f54680498c85e6ce41dd7c4e) - Testing different EL-CL client combinations on devnet-6; developing unified EL metrics proposal and continuing comparative performance analysis of execution clients. ## Spec / EIP Discussions | Topic | Subtopic | Details | |-------|----------|---------| | **BlobsBundleV2** | Formatting (flat vs. nested) | - Flat vs. nested structure for commitments/blobs/proofs arrays (FLCL) | | **BPO Schedule** | CL BPO blob schedule | - confirm agreement on config
- open PR: [Introduce blob only parameter forks](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4277) (note comment asking whether this should go into deneb) | | | EL BPO blob schedule | confirm agreement on config (any missing BPO-related PRs?) | ### Open Specs & Discussions - Consensus: Remove placeholder MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_FULU ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/4266)) - Consensus: Implement BPO fork blob limit logic ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/4267)) - Engine API: Add EIP-7594 (PeerDAS) related change ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/630)) - Builder: Add EIP-7594 (PeerDAS) related change ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/117)) - Update EIP-7594: Add blob count per tx limit via blobSchedule ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9623)) ### Draft Specs & Discussions - Update EIP-7594: Polish EIP, expand rationale ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9588)) ## Open Discussion | Topic | Subtopic | Details | |-------|----------|---------| | **Topic 1** | subtopic 1 | - details | | | subtopic 2 | - details | # Schedule | Date(s) | Item | |------|-----------| | April 9th | peerdas-devenet-6 live! | | May ~5th | Pectra Mainnet | | ~June 1st | fusaka-devnet-0 (w/ BPO) | | June 8-14 | EL / CL Interop | | Post June 14 | Audits: KZG libraries (c-kzg-4844, rust-eth-kzg, go-eth-kzg) |
